notes: All 35 source morphemes and 41 target tokens are partitioned exactly once.
`בֶן־יְמִינִי` fuses to *a Benjamite* headed on the gentilic, as in verse 1; `לָמָּה` fuses to *wherefore* headed on the morpheme carrying the wh-lexeme.

`כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה` is written with a word for the demonstrative and one for the noun, so rule 2 splits it and both articles are `unrepresented` (rules 41, 47); the waw beside the interrogative takes the *then* written for it.
The margin's Hebrew gloss *tribes* was read and set aside; the printed singular governs (rule 38).
